title: InterpretationEvidence
description: One institution-controlled instrument authorizing a reading. It deliberately mirrors the shape of AUTHORITY-EVIDENCE-v0.1 so a reviewer who can read one can read the other: an issuer, a basis reference, an exact source-instance binding, a bounded reach, a validity interval and a status. Two instrument kinds are distinguished. A REGISTERED_INTERPRETATION_RULE is a standing, machine-verifiable rule the institution has registered, sufficient for readings the source's own structure forces. An INSTITUTIONAL_INTERPRETATION_WARRANT is a specific institutional act, required for every reading the source does not force. A model can be neither: proposer output is not evidence.

evidence_digest.description: SHA-256 over Canonical JSON of this object with only its own evidence_digest omitted. A content-integrity binding, not a signature and not proof that the issuer was entitled to issue it.

interpretation_authority_id.description: The institutional interpretation authority. A model identifier may not appear here; a model cannot issue its own interpretation warrant.

applies_to.description: The exact source instance and the exact slots this instrument reaches. Binding to a source instance rather than to wording is what stops one warrant from silently authorizing a reading of similar text elsewhere.

permitted_operations.description: Closed vocabulary. An operation absent from this list is not authorized by this instrument, and there is no catch-all value.
